findings.text: The except branch calls _defer_to_a_queued_review(request, str(exc)), which is what runs, but passing str() discards the .refusals list _PromotionRefusalError carries, so refusal_awaits_a_review's part-wise branch (promotion_checks.py:1519) is dead on every call path. A run refused for a failing suite AND a missing review matches on the concatenated text and is requeued instead of refused; probed at the reviewed head: object form returns False, string form True, which is the form _run hands it. The docstring two lines above claims this case is separated.

No case queues a run whose refusal carries several reasons, so the part-wise discrimination the module claims is never exercised; a regression that turned every aggregate containing the review text into a deferral would stay green.

The node declares docs/figures/work-flows-to-the-lane/review-promoted-before-its-run and shipped no figure; the four-way ordering (review queued, run queued, refusal, requeue) it describes in prose is a diagram the graphics mandate expects.
